tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// dbyu gu mched gsum gyi sgrub thabs bklags pas grub pa yid bzhin nor bu'i za ma tog ces bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// nyi ma'i gnyen dang gsang bdag la// dngos po kun gyis phyag byas nas// chos ldan 'byor pa myur stsol ma// dbyu gu mched gsum sgrub thabs bshad// brgyud ldan gyi bla ma las 'di'i lung nos te yi dam lha'i bsnyen pa dang sgab 'dre mnan pa sngon du 'gro bas/ ro ras sam dar ram shing shun la gu gul gyis bdug ras 'dul byas la mtshal dang*/ pad rāg gam ma rnyed na bu mo gtsang ma'i gson khrag sin+dhu ra/ tsan+dan dmar po/ gur gum rnams bsres pa'i tshon gyis dbyu gu mched gsum gyi sku mngon rtogs ltar bris pa'i skya ris zin nas tshon gyi 'og tu gong gi rdzas kyis so so'i snying po bri/ rgyab tu'ang snying po'i mjug rang gi ming mthar dngos grub stsol ba'i 'dod gsol bris la rab gnas byas pa dang*/ mgron bu bu ma gsum gyi nang lha mo gsum so so'i sngags kyi shog dril bcug pa/ mu tig gsum/ bye ru gsum rnams 'du bya/ gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi'am yang na me tog gi tshom bu lnga'am dgu bkod pa'i steng tsaka li gsum lha'i bzhugs tshul ltar btsugs pa dang lhan cig bla rdo'ang dar gyis dril la rin po che'i snod 'bru dang 'bras bus bkang ba'i khar bzhugs/ de'i mdun du sha chang dkar gsum mngar gsum shing 'bras sogs kha zas bzang rgus brgyan pa'i chang bu gsum rin po che'i snod du bsham zhing*/ spro na dkar gtor zlum po gsum yang bshams la thun re bzhin chang bu gsum gyis kha gso/ gzhan yang nyer spyod sogs mchod pa ci 'byor bsham/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas rang nyid gnod sbyin mo kuṇ+ḍa lī mthing ga spyan gsum dmar ba phyag gnyis kyi bar na rin po che bsnams par bsgom pa'am/ gtso bor 'byung po 'dul byed sogs yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas byas nas/

mdun bskyed bris sku rten rdzas rnams lhar bskyed cing rgyun khyer lta bur rten med na gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar bsgom pa yin te/ mdun du mañdzu shī ka'i me tog gi/ 'dab stong bzhad rtser nor bdag gnod sbyin mo// kun nas 'khyil pa mched gsum gsal ba ni// dbus su thugs kyi ḍā ki dbang sngon mdog /g.yas su sku yi ḍā ki ljang ngam ser// g.yon du gsung gi ḍā ki bye ru bzhin// yang na gsum ga gnam sngon byugs 'dra ba// zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdzes 'dzum lha mo'i gzugs// sha rgyas sked phra myos bum rnam par mtho// dbu skra li sogs lang tsho gsar pa'i nyams// zab chen stod g.yogs dar dkar smad dkris gsol// sna tshogs rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras// phyag g.yas 'dod 'jo'i gter gyi bum bzang 'degs// g.yon pa yid bzhin nor bu thugs kar 'dzin// zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ldem tshul bzhengs// gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur// rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje gdan gyi lho nub kyi dur khrod chen po sogs gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas nor bdag sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma mched gsum 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi nor bdag mkha' 'gro ma gsum gyi thugs rgyud bskul bas 'khor dang sprul pa lcags kyu thogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams gang bar spros/ khams gsum gyi skye 'gro pho mo de rnams kyi kha rje dbang thang*/ zas gos 'bru nor la sogs pa'i longs spyod/ 'byung lnga'i bcud sogs rang dbang med par bsdus nas bdag dang gnas khang bang mdzod la thim zhing*/ mdun gyi lha mo dmar mos zas/ ljang mos gos/ sngon mos nor gyi char chen po bdag la stsal bas gnas khang bang mdzod yul phyogs thams cad phyur bur gang bar mos la bzla bya'i sngags ni/

oṃ i li ki li pi li ki ki li swā hā/ zhes pa gsung gi mkha' 'gro mas zas sgrub pa'i sngags dang*/ oṃ a na le kuṇ+ḍa lī gṛh+ṇa piṇ+ḍa pi shā tsi na ye swā hā/ sku'i mkha' 'gro mas gos sgrub pa'i sngags dang*/ oṃ na maḥshuk+ṣa ṇa bā su mu khaṃ ma hā pi shā tsi na ye swā hā/ thugs kyi mkha' 'gro mas nor sgrub pa'i sngags te gsum sbrel nas bzla ba'am so sor grangs mnyam du bzla ba gang bde byas pas chog dus bsnyen rgyas bsdus mang du bshad kyang sngags tshan rer zhag bdun re byed pa rgya gzhung dang mthun/ grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag re yin par brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun las byung*/ rtags ni nyams sam rmi lam du bud med mdzes mas phyag byed cing zas nor ster ba dang gter rnyed pa sogs byung na 'grub pa'i mtshan mar bshad/ bud med kyis 'thab pa dang yo byad 'phrog pa sogs bar chad kyi rtags yin pas yi dam lha'i bzlas sgom dang lta bas zil gyis mnan cing bshags pa dang tshogs gsog la 'bad pas bzlog rgyun bzlas byed na sngags tshan re re nas brgya'am nyer gcig gam bdun nam ci nus bzla/ gzhan yang*/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tsha me u me ni du kha then swā hā/ zhes pa rgyun bzlas la brten nas sgrub pa'i sngags yin pas srod la bzhi brgya'am brgya rtsa re bzlas na longs spyod char ltar 'bebs par 'gyur ro// thun mtshams su gtor ma chu chang gis bran/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs par 'bru gsum 'od du zhu ba las gtor ma 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i mthar se gol dang bcas/ oṃ i li ki li pi li ki ki li swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ a na le kuṇ+ḍa lī gṛh+ṇa piṇ+ḍa pi shā tsi na ye swā hā/ i daṃ= oṃ na maḥshuk+ṣa ṇa ba su mu khaṃ ma hā pi shā tsi na ye swā hā/

i daṃ= zhes lan bdun nam gsum res dbul/ oṃ ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ gnod sbyin sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bdag la zas skom dang*/ gos dang*/ 'bru nor longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i dngos grub da lta nyid du stsal du gsol/ de'ang log pa'i 'tsho bar nam yang mi 'gyur ba rang nyid chos sgrub pa'i 'tsho ba dang mchod dang sbyin pas bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog cing bstan pa dang sems can la sman pa'i sgo kho nar gyur te rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur smin pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes phrin las gsol/ hūm̐/ dur khrod shing drung nags tshal chen po ru// lhag par gnas bcas sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma// sgyu ma'i skur ston phrin las mdzad pa'i dpal// sna tshogs skur ston yid bzhin nor 'dra'i lha// dpag bsam shing ltar dgos 'dod re ba skong*// mi zad gter las grub pa'i bum pa 'dzin// 'dod yon ci 'dod 'byung la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji ltar bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzod// ces pas bstod/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs brtan bzhugs dang*/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// zhes sogs bsngo smon dang*/ 'bad dang stsol bas ma gos pa'i sogs shis brjod ji ltar rigs pas mtha' brgyan/ yi dwags la chu sbyin pa dang su rū pa'i gtor ma la ci nus su brtson par bya/ 'di nyid bsten cing sgrub pa'i dam tshig tu tshangs spyod dang gtsang sbra la gnas shing*/ bud med la rdeg btsog dang smad par mi bya/ byang chub kyi sems ma nyams par bya/ tshogs dang gtor ma la ci 'grub tu 'bad/ de ltar sgrub pa thems pa'i mthar gtor ma gtsang sar btang*/ lha bris sku sogs rten rdzas la brtan bzhugs byas nas bla rdo bris sku bcas dar dmar po dang rnyed na mi grir shi ba'i pags pas dril/

ras khug tu bcug la gzhan gyis ma mthong ba mchan khung du bcang ba'am dben par sba zhing mchod/ gong du smos pa ni bsnyen sgrub dang rgyun gyi nyams len la'ang nor lha gzhan dang sgo bstun nas gtor chog rgyas par bya ba'i dbang du bshad pa yin gyi/ rgyun khyer gyi skabs bsdu na kha zas za ba'i tshe mdun du mkha' 'gro ma gsum skad cig gis bskyed/ changs bu gsum byas pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir spel la gtor sngags kyis bsngo ba dang phrin las bcol ba sngar ltar byas nas changs bu gtsang sar gshegs shing srod kyi dus tsha me u me'i rgyun bzlas gong bzhin byas pa kho nas chog bsnyen pa thems nas las kha tshar gyi gtso bo byi ba rgya lpags kyi 'khor los zas nor spel ba ni/ ri dwags rgya'i pags pa gad brdar legs par byas pa la byi ba kha sprod rin po che skyugs shing sbo 'og tu nor bu mang du 'khyil ba'i gzugs gser gyis bris la tshon btang*/ gzugs kyi phyi byi ba g.yon ma'i mgo'i thad nas sngags mgo phyir bstan du dbu can tshag yod kyis/ oṃ swa sti sgo ru srungs sgo ru skyobs/ oṃ ma ma ti sgo ru srungs sgo ru skyobs/ nor bdag gser gyi byi ba pho mos bdag la gser dngul 'bru nor sogs gang 'dod 'di dang 'di lta bu'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes phreng gcig la 'khor bar bri/ de'i phyi rim mgo 'dzugs lugs sogs gong dang 'dra ba'i yig phreng gcig la mkha' 'gro ma gsum gyi sngags gsum dang*/ oṃ aṃ pa kaṃ pa zhi pa a/ oṃ ma se la dum pa zhi swā hā/ shong na de'i mjug tu mthud/ ma shong na rgyab logs su ye dharmā bri/ stong cha lus na gong ltar 'dod gsol bris la 'grigs par bskor/ de ḍā ki ma gsum du bskyed bstim rab gnas legs par byas la byi ba'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i dar gyis dril/ gzhan gyis ma mthong bar rang gi mchan du 'chang ba'am/

yang na zangs sam rdza'am shing gi za ma tog tu bcug pa'i srubs rnams rat+na lnga/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ spos lnga/ snying po lnga dang*/ g.yang rdzas sna tshogs kyis bkang la bang mdzod la sogs pa'i phug tu sbas la ci za ci 'thung gi phud dang nor phud kyis mchod na yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar dgos 'dod mtha' dag ngang gis 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de yang phye dang mar 'phel bar 'dod na byi ba dkar po byas la phye rkyal lam phye bang ngam mar sgom du bcug des 'gre bar nas la byi ba khra bo nas bang*/ nor spyi dang gos dang gser 'phel bar 'dod na byi ba ser po mdzod phug dang gos kyi gong ba dang gser snod kyi khar gdags/ sha la dmar po/ mi dang go cha mtshon la sngon po sogs rig pas 'phrul/ phyugs spel na byi ba nag po/ dbyu gu mched gsum dgra s+t+wa dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i sku shog bur bris pa dang lhan cig nor phyugs kyi sker gdags pa'am phyugs rwa'i phugs su sba bar gsungs/ 'khor lo la brten nas dbang du bya ba dang sgab 'dre gnon pa'i lag len ni dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi yig char shin tu gsal bas 'dir ma smos/ ༈ /mkha' 'gro lag sgul gyi gdams pa ni/ oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣā ya dha ra dha ra dhi ri dhi ri swā hā/ brgya rtsa re rgyun du bzlas pas zas nor ster ba rtsol med du 'ong zhing*/ nangs par snga bar langs la/ oṃ ma se la dum pa zhi piṇ+ḍe swā hā/ brgya rtsa bzlas nas lhung bzed la bsngags na bsod snyoms rnyed par 'gyur ro// mkha' 'gro ma gsum sku mdog tha dad du byas par thun mong ba dang*/ sngon po rkyang pa byas par thun mong min pa'i ming 'dogs dang rjes gnang yang so sor mdzad pa'i srol yang mchis mod kyi nor gtso bor sgrub pa'i dbang gis sku mdog sngon por byas pa las bye brag tha dad du mi bsam zhing*/ sgrub pa'i skabs su lha mo gsum dgra s+t+wa dang thod pa nor bus gang ba bsnams par sgom pa'i tshul yang rdo rje gdan pas mdzad par grags pa'i don 'grel las gsungs mod/

'dir 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi rgya gzhung gi dngos bstan dang*/ phyag len gyi rgyun ltar bkod pa yin/ de bzhin du i li ki li'i sngags 'di med pa'i yig cha'ang mang du mthong mod rgya gzhung rtsa ba yid ches kyi dpang du bzung nas bris so// 'di nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon ni/ chos dang mthun pa'i zas gos nor gsum gyis mi phongs shing*/ dge bshes dang mi chen po sogs dbang du 'du ba dang*/ mi thams cad gus par 'gyur zhing tha na khyi la sogs pas kyar byams par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'byung po thams cad kyis kyang grogs byed par bshad cing*/ changs bu la brten nas rgyun du sgrub pa 'di rgyun du bgyis na 'chi ba bslu ba'i mchog kyang yin par gsungs pas chos tshul bzhin byed pa'i blo ldan rnams kyis nyams su len pa la 'bad pa rigs so// nor sgrub zab mo grags mang yang*// bya sla myur 'grub chos ldan gyi// 'byor pa 'phel byed 'di yin phyir// snying nas chos byed rnams la 'os// dbyu gu mched gsum gyi sgrub thabs bklags pas grub pa 'di'ang las smon mthun pa'i slob bu blo gsal gyis nye bar bskul nas bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub kyis bris pa'o// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ 'dir dbyu gu mched gsum gyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ gnas dben par pad+ma 'dab bzhi'am/ tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i steng du mañdzi'i khar sku tsaka 'dzugs/ ma 'byor na tshom bu gsum 'god/ mdun du gtor zlum mtha' chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod spyi ltar bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang zhes sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/

steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'bar bas yongs su bskor ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma drag po dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa la phug 'dzin pa/ mgo bo g.yon gyi phyogs su bstan pa 'gyel ba'i steng du rang gi sems yi ge hūm̐ sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs dang*/ nus pa thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar te 'dzin pa/ g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis rang gi phyag rgya thugs kar bsnol ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che dang sbrul chen po brgyad kyis brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sku che zhing yan lag rags pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu mām̐/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar sngags bkod par dmigs te/ oṃ bhū ta ḍa ma ra bhū ta a dhi pa ti/ ak+ṣo bh+yaḥki rī ṭi ṇa sarba bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsi na ut+sā dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam/ de nas maṇ+ḍal steng gi bris sku la dmigs te ngag tu/ rang nyid khro bo'i dbang po'i skur gsal ba'i// mdun du sna tshogs pad gdan gsum gyi steng*// nor gyi lha mo dbyu gu mched gsum po// sku mdog in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs dang ldan// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas rin po che'i// rab mdzes bum pa nor bu gang ba dang*// g.yon pas nor bu 'bar bas sangs rgyas la// mchod cing 'gro la dgos 'dod stsol ba 'dzin// zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang dbu rgyan can// zhal 'dzum sha rgyas nu 'bur zung gis mdzes// rab dkar srab 'jam dar gyis smad g.yogs shing*// sna tshogs dar gyi lhab lhub du ma gsol// yid 'ong rin chen du mas spras pa'i sku// rnam gsum mngon sum lta bur gsal bar gyur// ces brjod cing bsams la/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi lho nub mtshams kyi dur khrod nas nor gyi lha mo dbyu gu mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par thim pas ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur/ de nas mchod pa kha gso byin rlabs bya/ oṃ ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐/ dur khrod shing drung sogs kyis bstod/

gtor mar chab bran bsang sbyangs byin rlabs byas te/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis 'byung po 'dul byed spyan drangs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la bhū ta ḍa ma ra sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ mchod bstod dang 'dod don spyi ltar zhu/ yang gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis brlabs la/ oṃ i li ki li sogs kyis 'bul/ slar mchod bstod dang*/ gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro spun gsum 'khor bcas la// bdag gis mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di phul bas// bdag gzhan don du byang chub sgrub pa la// sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin 'bras bsod nams ni// yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i don slad du// bdag la zas nor longs spyod rab 'phel zhing*// de nyid log pa'i 'tsho bar mi 'gyur bar// 'du zhing bsod nams rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// zhes phrin bcol byas nas/ mdun gyi lha mo gsum gyi thugs rgyud bskul zhing bka' nyan par bsams la/ oṃ i li ki li pi li ki ki li swā hā/ oṃ a na le kuṇ+ḍa lī gṛh+ṇa piṇ+ḍa pi shā tsi na ye swā hā/ oṃ na ma shuk+ṣa ṇa ba su mu khaṃ ma hā pi shī tsi na ye swā hā/ zhes ḍā ki ma gsum gyi sngags ci nus su bzla bar bya'o// de nas slob ma 'dus nas chos bshad rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs gsol gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs rgyun bshags/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs khyad par gyi gsol gdab bya/ rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa'i slad du slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi phung po khams dang bskyed mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i nga las pam̐ las pad+ma zhes pa nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar gong ltar bskyed/ mdun bskyed sngar yod gsal btab la/ slob ma 'byung po 'dul byed skur gsal ba'i/ mdun du sna tshogs pad gdan nas/ ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par mched gsum gong ltar bskyed/

de nas sku yi rjes gnang gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbyu gu mched gsum spyan drangs te slob ma 'byung po 'dul byed du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la bstim zhing*/ spos rol sogs spyi ltar bya/ de nas lung gsum las rjes su bzlas pa lan gsum bya/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs/ sngags lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// sogs dam bca' ba spyi dang mthun/ byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ rigs 'dra bstim/ rjes gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal sogs gong 'og thams cad sgrub brgya'i chings ltar bya'o// rjes chog spyi ltar bya/ dbyu gu mched gsum la sa ngor jo nang la rang rkang med/ gong dkar ba'i brgyud pa rnams su rjes gnang mdzad cing*/ de la thun mong lha mo gsum sku mdog dmar sngo ljang gsum so sor byed pa'i rjes gnang*/ thun min gsum ka sngon po byed pa'i rjes gnang sogs bzhugs kyang*/ thun min thob na thun mong zhar du thob pa yin no// zhes pa 'di'ang rje bla ma'i gsung zin tho ltar blo gter dbang pos bkod pa yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs chos rgyan no// 'dis kyang sems can thams cad chos mthun gyi 'byor pa la dbang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// //
